label: POC Onboarding: Trim Environment Order Form
mcp_tool_description: Shorten an environment's order form to what a POC user needs. CloudBolt hides a required parameter that has exactly one option, so the poc_minimal profile pins infrastructure choices to one value (AWS key pair, security group, EBS type; Azure resource group, storage type, public IP; vCenter datastore, disk type; never NIC 1, whose choices onb_environment_networks sets) and removes the optional technology parameters a POC never touches, leaving the size (and on Azure the Windows password) visible. onb_profile=report changes nothing and lists every parameter with whether it shows on the form. onb_keep names fields to leave visible, onb_pin lines field=value choose the pinned value, onb_remove names extra fields to remove. Pinned fields are protected from the handler's sync jobs. Echo the plan to the user and confirm before calling. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
